mapper.sql: p.page_id, p.space_id, p.parent_id, p.page_type, p.title, p.summary, p.content, p.sort_order, p.content_version, p.lifecycle_status, p.create_user_id, p.update_user_id, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, coalesce(nullif(creator.nick_name, ''), creator.user_name, p.create_by) as creator_name, coalesce(nullif(modifier.nick_name, ''), modifier.user_name, p.update_by) as modifier_name
mapper.select: select space_id, space_name, description, sort_order, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from kb_space where status = '0' order by sort_order, space_id
select space_id, space_name, description, sort_order, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from kb_space where space_id = #{spaceId}
mapper.insert: insert into kb_space(space_name, description, sort_order, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values(#{spaceName}, #{description}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now())
mapper.update: update kb_space set space_name = #{spaceName}, description = #{description}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where space_id = #{spaceId}
mapper.select: select p.page_id, p.space_id, p.parent_id, p.page_type, p.title, p.sort_order, p.content_version, p.lifecycle_status, p.update_time, coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name, ''), u.user_name, p.update_by) as modifier_name from kb_page p left join sys_user u on u.user_id = p.update_user_id where p.space_id = #{spaceId} and ((p.page_type = 'FOLDER' and p.lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE') or (p.page_type = 'ARTICLE' and p.lifecycle_status = #{lifecycleStatus})) order by p.parent_id, p.sort_order, p.page_type desc, p.title

select p.page_id, p.space_id, p.parent_id, p.title, p.summary, p.content_version, p.update_time, coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name, ''), u.user_name, p.update_by) as modifier_name, group_concat(distinct t.tag_name order by t.tag_name separator '、') as tag_names from kb_page p left join sys_user u on u.user_id = p.update_user_id left join kb_page_tag pt on pt.page_id = p.page_id left join kb_tag t on t.tag_id = pt.tag_id where p.page_type = 'ARTICLE' and p.lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE' and (#{spaceId} is null or p.space_id = #{spaceId}) and ( instr(lower(p.title), lower(#{keyword})) > 0 or instr(lower(coalesce(p.summary, '')), lower(#{keyword})) > 0 or instr(lower(coalesce(p.content, '')), lower(#{keyword})) > 0 or exists(select 1 from kb_page_tag search_pt join kb_tag search_tag on search_tag.tag_id = search_pt.tag_id where search_pt.page_id = p.page_id and instr(lower(search_tag.tag_name), lower(#{keyword})) > 0) ) group by p.page_id, p.space_id, p.parent_id, p.title, p.summary, p.content_version, p.update_time, u.nick_name, u.user_name, p.update_by order by p.update_time desc, p.page_id desc limit #{limit}
select from kb_page p left join sys_user creator on creator.user_id = p.create_user_id left join sys_user modifier on modifier.user_id = p.update_user_id where p.page_id = #{pageId}
select from kb_page p left join sys_user creator on creator.user_id = p.create_user_id left join sys_user modifier on modifier.user_id = p.update_user_id where p.page_id = #{pageId} for update
select count(1) from kb_page where parent_id = #{pageId}
select coalesce(max(sort_order), 0) + 10 from kb_page where space_id = #{spaceId} and parent_id = #{parentId} and lifecycle_status != 'TRASH'
mapper.insert: insert into kb_page(space_id, parent_id, page_type, title, summary, content, sort_order, content_version, lifecycle_status, create_user_id, update_user_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values(#{spaceId}, #{parentId}, #{pageType}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{sortOrder}, #{contentVersion}, #{lifecycleStatus}, #{createUserId}, #{updateUserId}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now())
mapper.update: update kb_page set space_id = #{page.spaceId}, parent_id = #{page.parentId}, title = #{page.title}, summary = #{page.summary}, content = #{page.content}, sort_order = #{page.sortOrder}, content_version = #{page.contentVersion}, lifecycle_status = #{page.lifecycleStatus}, update_user_id = #{page.updateUserId}, update_by = #{page.updateBy}, update_time = now() where page_id = #{page.pageId} and page_type = 'ARTICLE' and content_version = #{expectedVersion}

update kb_page set space_id = #{spaceId}, parent_id = #{parentId}, title = #{title}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, update_user_id = #{updateUserId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where page_id = #{pageId} and page_type = 'FOLDER'
mapper.delete: delete from kb_page where page_id = #{pageId} and page_type = 'FOLDER'
mapper.select: select t.tag_name from kb_page_tag pt join kb_tag t on t.tag_id = pt.tag_id where pt.page_id = #{pageId} order by t.tag_name
mapper.insert: insert ignore into kb_tag(tag_name, create_by, create_time) values(#{tagName}, #{operator}, now())
mapper.select: select tag_id from kb_tag where tag_name = #{tagName}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into kb_page_tag(page_id, tag_id) values(#{pageId}, #{tagId})
mapper.select: select document_id from kb_page_document where page_id = #{pageId} order by sort_order, link_id
mapper.insert: insert into kb_page_document(page_id, document_id, sort_order, create_by, create_time) values(#{pageId}, #{documentId}, #{sortOrder}, #{operator}, now())

insert into kb_page_version(page_id, version_no, snapshot_space_id, snapshot_parent_id, snapshot_title, snapshot_summary, snapshot_content, snapshot_lifecycle_status, snapshot_tags, snapshot_document_ids, operation_type, change_fields, change_note, content_checksum, operator_id, operator_name, restored_from_version, create_time) values(#{pageId}, #{versionNo}, #{snapshotSpaceId}, #{snapshotParentId}, #{snapshotTitle}, #{snapshotSummary}, #{snapshotContent}, #{snapshotLifecycleStatus}, #{snapshotTags}, #{snapshotDocumentIds}, #{operationType}, #{changeFields}, #{changeNote}, #{contentChecksum}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{restoredFromVersion}, now())
mapper.select: select version_id, page_id, version_no, operation_type, change_fields, change_note, content_checksum, operator_id, operator_name, restored_from_version, create_time from kb_page_version where page_id = #{pageId} order by version_no desc

select version_id, page_id, version_no, snapshot_space_id, snapshot_parent_id, snapshot_title, snapshot_summary, snapshot_content, snapshot_lifecycle_status, snapshot_tags, snapshot_document_ids, operation_type, change_fields, change_note, content_checksum, operator_id, operator_name, restored_from_version, create_time from kb_page_version where page_id = #{pageId} and version_no = #{versionNo}
